basis: Authorizes ONLY the base-comparator scoring job b5-arm2-score-base-byvgen-2026-001 ($1.60 worst case, 1,346 rows), job 1 of 3 in the Medumba generalisation experiment (additional runtime capped at $6.40). Scores the UNADAPTED BASE in base_mode; the candidate will be trained from the same base, so neither side has seen the held-out material. The split is FROZEN before any job: rule sha256('byv-genz-2026/'+speaker_id) ascending, first 15 speakers held out; TRAIN_POOL 2,895 rows sha 79bdf7fd, eval manifest 1,346 rows sha 08c959df. G2 (89 rows, 12 speakers) is the PRIMARY endpoint with verified zero audio, speaker and prompt overlap with TRAIN_POOL. PREREGISTERED: IMPROVES iff candidate <= base - 2.00 CER AND the speaker-clustered 95% CI excludes 0; otherwise the reading is 'criterion not met' - NEVER 'Medumba cannot improve'. 'Unseen' means excluded from THIS adaptation run; the base model's original pretraining exposure is unknown. EXPLORATORY: one speaker supplies 61% of the primary endpoint's weight, so per-speaker changes are reported alongside the pooled figure. No TEST scoring, no serving change, no retry, no follow-on.
